hot_leads.title: Co-Founder

No instant booking calendar (Calendly, Acuity, GHL) - friction in scheduling and lost appointments
No automated lead confirmation / instant auto-responder - leads go cold waiting for a reply
Slow website load time (5238ms) - losing impatient leads
No Google Reviews displayed on website - missing trust signals

Slow infrastructure - needs modern solution
